{{Top|leg}}
The '''Second Hollastin Insurrection''' was an uprising on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hollast VII]]. During the insurrection, a number of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] tried to take advantage of the confusion and eliminate [[Glorga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
